set.name: Fates: Festival of Beasts
set.theme: Mid-set update to Fates. Traits added: Blacksmith, Daredevil, Dragonsoul, Executioner, Fabled, Slayer, Syphoner. Removed: Dazzler, Dusk, Hunter, Moonlight, Shade, Tormented.

notes.itemScope: Items come from the patch 11.8 CDragon file. Legacy entries left in that file from earlier sets were dropped: where two items share a recipe, the one with this set's icon tag was kept; disabled items (negative ids) and internal placeholders were dropped.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Chosen continued with retuned odds: L6 0/60/40/0/0, L8 0/0/60/40/0, L9 0/0/0/60/40. 11.4: base Chosen chance 33% to 50%, bonuses reduced (300 HP, 15% AP, 10 AD, 15% mana reduction). [11.2 notes, wiki Chosen]
Lanterns: a mid-set drop that may appear at various times or not at all, containing components, Loaded Dice, gold, and more. [11.2 notes]
Blacksmith (Ornn): after each combat Ornn participates in, he makes progress forging an Artifact (Ornn item); higher star level works faster. Each ally may equip only one Artifact. [11.2 notes]
Consumables in data: Loaded Dice, Reforger, Magnetic Remover, Target Dummy. [CDragon]
systemChanges: First carousel: the all-defensive-component version was replaced by 2 Sword, 2 Bow, 2 Rod, 2 Tear, 1 Glove. [11.2 notes]
